section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the difference between a general call to God and a true call through Torah, which brings a deeper closeness.
section.t: And there is to add explanation in what is said in the continuation of the verse, “to all who call Him in truth,”
for the matter of “close to all who call Him” equally
is from the aspect of a simple call,
an external call,
and above this is the closeness to “all who call Him in truth,”
which is the matter of an inner call,
which is a call in truth,
for then He is close in the utmost way,
and as explained elsewhere22
that “they call Him in truth” refers to the Torah,
“there is no truth but Torah,”23
for specifically through the Torah is the inner drawing down.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the revelation of the level of Havayah above required the Exodus and the Giving of the Torah, drawing from a higher source beyond limitation.
section.t: And based on this24 there is to explain with additional elucidation the connection of the revelation of Havayah above to the Exodus from Egypt and the Giving of the Torah,
for in order for there to be a descent also to the lower ones
(which was innovated at the Giving of the Torah)
there must be a drawing down from a more elevated aspect.
In the manner explained in the maamar, that in order for there to be “the God of the King” and especially “and I will bless Your name forever and ever,” there must be “I will exalt You.”
And this is “And God spoke to Moshe and said to him, ‘I am Havayah,’”
that initially the revelation of the Name Havayah was specifically through the Name Elokim,
and “My Name Havayah above I was not known to them.”
But in order to take Israel out of Egypt and for there to be the Giving of the Torah,
there must be drawn from a higher place,
from the aspect of Havayah above.
It is written,25
“Great is Havayah and exceedingly praised in the city of our God,”
and our sages, of blessed memory, said,26
“When is He great? When He is in the city of our God,”
that through the city of our God27
Havayah comes in a multiplicity of divisions to bring into being a multitude of creations,
“How manifold are Your works, Havayah!”28
(and also the bringing into being of “How great are Your works, Havayah!”29
is specifically through His coming into the city of our God).
However, the aspect of Havayah in His own essence is above division,
“He was, He is, and He will be as one,”30
and even to simple unity,
which is “and to His greatness there is no investigation,”31
which is the aspect of the greatness of Havayah in His own essence.
And behold, the aspect of the Name Havayah as it is contracted through the Name Elokim,
since it is a contracted and limited light,
is drawn only to Atzilus,
and in order for it to be drawn also below into the worlds of Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah,
and even to this lowest world, beneath which there is no lower32
(the connection of the upper and lower that was innovated at the Giving of the Torah),
there must be drawn the Name Havayah that is above vestiture in the Name Elokim,
which is the aspect of Havayah above.
And based on this will be understood what Rashi explained: “I was not known to them in My attribute of truth,”
for seemingly, how can it be said that the attribute of truth was not revealed to the Patriarchs,
and especially to Yaakov, whose attribute is the attribute of truth?33
Rather, the intention is that the aspect of Havayah above was not revealed to them,
which is specifically His attribute of truth,
in the manner of what is said, “You give truth to Yaakov,”34
that even to Yaakov, whose attribute is the attribute of truth,
there is need to draw down the aspect of the supernal truth, the truth of Havayah.35
And this is what was innovated at the Exodus from Egypt and the Giving of the Torah,
that the aspect of the Name Havayah above shone then,
and more particularly,
the Name Havayah of the aspect of Atik.
And likewise it will be in the future,
as it is said,36
“As in the days of your going out from the land of Egypt, I will show him wonders,”
that there will then be a revelation of the Name Havayah above,
the aspect of “My attribute of truth,”
and even more than at the time of the Exodus from Egypt,37
for “I will show him the wonders” that at the Exodus from Egypt “and My face shall not be seen.”38
And behold, all the revelations of the future depend39
on our deeds and service during the time of exile,
therefore now the service must be above measure and limitation,
in the manner of the statement of our sages, of blessed memory, on the verse “And I appeared,” that the service must be in a manner of “they did not question,”40
“and I am Havayah,”
faithful41
to pay a good reward and to fulfill His promises, “and I will take you out, and I will save, and I will redeem, and I will take,”42
— which was said to Moshe, the faithful shepherd,
“He is the first redeemer, He is the final redeemer,”43
may he come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,
speedily in our days.
